interface.name: wc_native_shm_v1

description.summary: original shared backing for a shipped Wayland toolkit

interface.description: A local proxy allocator for Cairo wl_shm buffers. Allocation happens before the toolkit maps or paints memory. A production allocation names a registered broker region; the client opens its own authenticated lease. The client then passes the original bounded fd in wl_shm.create_pool. Caller-claimed region ownership is never sufficient for recognition. Allocation failure must not turn into a payload-copy fallback in strict mode. This object, like wl_shm, lives until its display connection ends.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: unique among this object's live allocations

request.name: release

description.summary: the toolkit has finished with its original mapping

request.description: Sent after Cairo use ends and the allocation's wl_buffers and wl_shm_pool are destroyed. It does not certify compositor or GPU drain. The server retains the allocation until its independent downstream lifetime ends.
